Batch-read PEAKS export folders and merge them into raw long format

Source: R/loaders-peaks.R
read_peaks_batch.Rd

Indexes the PEAKS export subfolders (via get_dirs_index_peaks()), selects which to read, then reads and row-binds each one with read_peaks(). Three input modes are supported (checked in priority order):

Usage

read_peaks_batch(
  folder = NULL,
  annotation = NULL,
  files = NULL,
  instrument = "tims_tof"
)

Arguments

folder

Top-level directory containing the PEAKS export subfolders. Required when using annotation or scan-all modes; may be NULL when files is supplied.

annotation

Optional annotation data frame (output of read_annot()). When provided without files, only subfolders whose basename is in annotation$Sample_peaks are read.

files

Optional character vector of PEAKS export folder paths to read directly, bypassing the directory index.

instrument

Passed to read_peaks(); one of "tims_tof", "faims_orbi", "orbi".

Value

The raw long-format PEAKS data frame across every matched subfolder, with Sample_peaks identifying the source subfolder of each row.

Details

  1. files — character vector of PEAKS export folder paths; uses those directly, bypassing the directory index.

  2. annotation — filters the directory index to subfolders whose basename is listed in annotation$Sample_peaks.

  3. neither — all non-QC PEAKS subfolders under folder are read.

The metadata join (adding Condition, BioReplicate, Sample, etc.) happens in annotate_peaks(), not here. This function returns the raw long-format PEAKS data only.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
read_peaks_batch(file.path("2_data", "peaks_xpro"), annotation,
                 instrument = "tims_tof")

# explicit folder paths
read_peaks_batch(files = c("peaks_xpro/JY_01", "peaks_xpro/JY_02"))
} # }
